final_resume.summary: QA Engineer with 2 years of hands-on experience testing embedded systems and BLE devices, seeking a Software Development Engineer role to apply strong problem-solving and attention to detail in building scalable systems. Proficient in C, C++, and Python with a solid foundation in embedded development and test automation.

bullets: Tested BLE pairing and GATT services across 12 Android and iOS devices for a wearable product line, ensuring protocol compliance and reliability.
Automated 150 firmware regression test cases using Python and pytest, reducing regression cycle time from 3 days to 1 day and improving release velocity.
Collaborated with firmware developers to log, triage, and resolve defects in JIRA during 2-week sprints, maintaining product quality standards.

projects.name: ESP32 BLE Sensor Logger
projects.description: Personal project during the career break: C firmware on ESP32 with FreeRTOS that advertises temperature readings over BLE and logs them to flash.

profile_improvement_tips: Study and implement classic data structures (linked lists, trees, hash tables) and algorithms (sorting, searching, graph traversal) in C or C++; add a project demonstrating these to your portfolio.
Learn object-oriented design principles (SOLID, design patterns) and refactor your ESP32 project or build a new one using OOP concepts in C++ to show practical application.

Explore distributed systems concepts (message queues, eventual consistency, consensus) through online courses or hobby projects; even a small multi-device BLE mesh or IoT coordinator project would strengthen your candidacy.
final_resume.growth_note: Your QA and embedded background is valuable, but the Software Development Engineer role emphasizes data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and OOP design—areas not yet evidenced in your profile. Upskilling in these core CS fundamentals is essential to be competitive for this role.
